content:
Roof rejuvenation is a preservation treatment for aging asphalt shingles.
As shingles age, the asphalt components can become dry and less flexible. A rejuvenation treatment is designed to penetrate the shingles and help restore properties that are lost through aging and weather exposure.
title: What is roof rejuvenation?

content:
We begin by evaluating the condition of your asphalt shingle roof to determine whether rejuvenation is appropriate.
If the roof is a good candidate, it is prepared for treatment and the rejuvenation product is applied evenly across the shingle surface.
The goal is to preserve a roof that still has useful service life remaining rather than replacing it prematurely.
title: How does Shingle Renew Pro work?

content:
Our Product is an asphalt shingle preservation treatment developed by SoyLei Innovative Products.
According to the manufacturer, the treatment is chemically attracted to aged asphalt molecules and is designed to absorb into shingles and redistribute components within the shingle to improve performance.
title: What is Our Product?

content:
No.
Roof cleaning is primarily intended to remove algae, organic growth, dirt, staining, and other surface contamination.
Roof rejuvenation is intended to help preserve the physical properties of aging asphalt shingles.
Depending on the condition of the roof, cleaning or other preparation may be recommended before rejuvenation.
title: Is roof rejuvenation the same as roof cleaning?

content:
No.
Roof rejuvenation is intended for aging asphalt shingle roofs that are still structurally serviceable.
A roof with extensive leaks, severely deteriorated shingles, major storm damage, rotten decking, widespread missing shingles, or other serious problems may require repairs or replacement instead.
That is why we evaluate the roof before recommending treatment.
title: Can every asphalt shingle roof be rejuvenated?

content:
Some common signs of an aging asphalt shingle roof include granules collecting in gutters, shingles becoming dry or brittle, fading, weathering, minor cracking, and loss of flexibility.
Age alone does not determine whether a roof qualifies.
The overall condition of the shingles, roof system, flashing, decking, and other components should be considered before treatment.
title: How do I know if my roof may be a good candidate?

content:
Our Product is designed to improve shingle grit retention.
Manufacturer literature reports improved grit retention in treated shingles and states that Our Product can improve shingle grit retention by up to 50%.
No roof treatment can guarantee that granule loss will completely stop, and results depend on the age and condition of the roof.
title: Can roof rejuvenation help reduce granule loss?

content:
Yes. Improving the flexibility of aging asphalt shingles is one of the primary purposes of the treatment.
Manufacturer testing reports a significant improvement in flexibility and durability after treatment, with treated aged shingles demonstrating flexibility approaching that of newer shingles.
Individual results depend on the condition of the roof before treatment.
title: Can Our Product improve shingle flexibility?

content:
The manufacturer of Our Product states that the treatment can add approximately six years of roof life.
This should not be interpreted as a guarantee that every treated roof will last exactly six additional years.
Remaining roof life depends on many factors, including the roof’s current condition, installation quality, weather exposure, ventilation, previous damage, and maintenance.
title: How much longer can roof rejuvenation extend the life of my roof?

content:
The manufacturer’s current literature recommends reapplication approximately every five years.
The appropriate timing for an individual roof can depend on its age, condition, climate, sun exposure, and other environmental factors.
title: How often should Our Product be applied?

content:
No.
Our Product is not intended to create a thick painted or coated layer over the shingles.
The product is designed to absorb into asphalt shingles and interact with aged asphalt components rather than simply covering the surface.
title: Is Our Product a roof coating or paint?

content:
The primary purpose of roof rejuvenation is preservation, not changing the color of the roof.
The appearance of weathered shingles may improve after treatment and preparation, but results will vary depending on shingle age, original color, staining, algae growth, and granule condition.
It should not be considered a substitute for painting or installing a different shingle color.
title: Will rejuvenation change the color of my roof?

content:
No.
Roof rejuvenation is not a substitute for necessary roofing repairs.
Leaks caused by damaged flashing, missing shingles, penetrations, deteriorated decking, installation defects, or other roofing problems should be repaired before rejuvenation treatment.
title: Will roof rejuvenation fix a leaking roof?

content:
Manufacturer testing reports a reduction in flame spread on treated shingles.
This does not mean that a treated roof becomes fireproof, and the treatment should not be represented as changing a roof assembly’s official fire classification unless supported by the applicable certified testing and documentation.
title: Does Our Product improve fire resistance?

content:
The manufacturer describes Our Product as environmentally and family friendly and states that the treatment produces no odors.
As with any professional roof treatment, application should still be performed according to the manufacturer’s instructions and appropriate site-protection procedures.
title: Is Our Product environmentally friendly?

content:
For a roof that still qualifies for treatment, rejuvenation can be substantially less expensive than tearing off and replacing the entire roof.
The actual cost depends on factors such as roof size, pitch, accessibility, condition, preparation requirements, and repairs that may be needed.
We provide pricing after evaluating the roof.
title: Is roof rejuvenation less expensive than roof replacement?

content:
The amount of time required depends on the size, pitch, accessibility, cleanliness, and condition of the roof.
Preparation and treatment requirements can vary from one property to another, so we evaluate the roof before providing a project schedule.
title: How long does the roof rejuvenation process take?

content:
In most cases, no.
Roof rejuvenation work is performed on the exterior of the home.
Before treatment begins, we will explain any preparation or access requirements that apply to your property.
title: Do I need to leave my home during treatment?

content:
Possibly.
The roof needs to be evaluated to determine whether the asphalt shingle areas requiring treatment are sufficiently accessible.
Solar panels, mounting hardware, roof penetrations, and the condition of the surrounding shingles all need to be considered before treatment.
title: Can a roof with solar panels be rejuvenated?

content:
We will tell you.
Roof rejuvenation is not appropriate for every roof.
If we find that the roof is too deteriorated, has significant damage, or needs repairs or replacement instead, we will explain what we found rather than recommending a treatment that is not appropriate for the roof.
title: What happens if my roof does not qualify for rejuvenation?

content:
Start with a roof assessment.
We will evaluate the condition of your asphalt shingle roof and determine whether rejuvenation appears to be an appropriate option.
If the roof qualifies, we can then explain the recommended preparation, treatment process, and pricing.
